title: Comparative safety of immune checkpoint inhibitors in cancer: systematic review and network meta-analysis.
instruction_inclusive_ORIGINAL: Does this study provide potentially relevant evidence on immune checkpoint inhibitor safety in patients with cancer?
instruction_inclusive: Does this study report safety, tolerability, or adverse event data for any immune checkpoint inhibitor (anti-PD-1, anti-PD-L1, anti-CTLA-4, or combination) in adult or paediatric patients receiving treatment for any solid tumour or haematological malignancy — including treatment-related adverse events, immune-related adverse events, discontinuation due to toxicity, or treatment-related deaths?
_rationale: Original is broad but abstract-level. Many clinical trials of checkpoint inhibitors report adverse events as secondary outcomes without foregrounding them in the abstract title/first sentence. Explicit enumeration of ICI drug classes and adverse-event outcome types may improve recall for studies where safety is a secondary endpoint.
